title: May 13 EOD — ATH day across the board. Market shrugged off hot PPI. China trip catalyst driving Mag 7.
marketTone: Momentum market. S&P +0.58% ATH. Nasdaq +1.21%. Tech led everything. Hot PPI ignored. Jensen, Cook, Musk all on China trip with Trump. Iran overnight is the only real wildcard. Multiple names with fresh 4H crosses and room to run. Best trade tomorrow is the name that pulls back cleanly to a key level in premarket.

macro.iran: Trump-Xi summit ongoing. Trump said he'll have a long talk about Iran. No escalation overnight — constructive. Monitor for any Hormuz headlines.
macro.ppi: April PPI +1.4% monthly — biggest jump since March 2022. +6% year-over-year — biggest since December 2022. Market ignored it entirely.
macro.oil: WTI pulling back slightly from $101+ highs — mild tailwind for tech.
macro.fed: 30% probability of rate hike this year per CME FedWatch. No cuts in 2026.
macro.breadth: Nasdaq +1.21%. S&P +0.58% ATH. Only MSFT red on the day. Tech and AI carrying the market.
macro.chinaTrip: Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, Elon Musk all on Trump-Xi summit delegation. Direct catalyst for NVDA, AAPL, TSLA.

tradeLesson: Macro event days require wider OCO and fewer contracts. Same max dollar risk — more breathing room. The flush IS the setup on volatile open days. Never enter when 2m SMI already above +60 or below -60 — wait for the reset and the cross. Re-entry discipline — after first 30 minutes the bar is significantly higher.
